notes: A shopping quantity is a retail box, not a cabinet: speaker_units states how many cabinets one box contains.
connection.feeds_per_box is the number of separately powered destinations one box must feed. A master/slave desktop pair feeds one cabinet; two independently powered monitors feed two.
connection.channels_per_feed is 2 when one cabinet accepts a stereo input pair and 1 when every cabinet takes a single mono channel.
included_cables lists leads that ship in the box, with the number of feeds they cover. A lead in the box is never a purchase.
cable.a and cable.b are the plug families at the source and speaker end. b_plugs is how many speaker-end plugs one purchase provides; pack_of is how many physical leads one purchase contains.
Items flagged estimate_only are planning allowances, not verified retailer products: they carry a cost but no SKU and no retailer link.

A lead in the box is a passive conductor assembly: the same plugs carry signal either way round, so included_cables entries are matched in both orientations. Set "directional": true on any lead that contains electronics (a DI box, an active converter, a USB audio adapter) and it will only be matched in its documented direction.

controller.outputs[] entries are physical sockets. One stereo output feeds one speaker line; a second line needs its own output. The model reports that as an unresolved route instead of pricing another cable, because Offbeat has no verified splitter to sell.
